plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells a small story about Gwynne Shotwell, the chief operating officer of the rocket company SpaceX, who he says basically runs the company now. According to Michels, Shotwell says she wears her special shoes for launches. He tells it to show that even the people at the top of hard engineering keep little rituals, and he credits it to a work called Countdown to Launch.
